name: What preparation is needed before a bathtub removal crew arrives?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before a bathtub removal crew arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before work begins, clear all personal toiletries, shower curtains, and shelving from the room, and empty the vanity cabinets if plumbing lines share a wall. Create a clear walking path from the bathroom to the home entrance by moving decorative furniture and rolling back hallway rugs. It is also helpful to confirm where your main water shutoff valve is located in case local fixture shutoffs are corroded or frozen in place.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear personal items from the bathroom, ensure a wide pathway to the exterior door, and locate your main water shutoff valve in case fixture valves fail.
